records.dataset_name: Supplementary Materials: intraoperative ICG assessment of hepatic congestion after major hepatic vein resection
records.medical_scene: human hepatic resection with ICG assessment of congestion after major hepatic vein resection
records.anatomy_scope: liver and hepatic venous perfusion; no jaw, exposed bone, osteomyelitis, or osteonecrosis target
records.modality: two human intraoperative ICG MP4 supplementary videos with composite white-light, green pseudocolor overlay, and grayscale fluorescence panels
records.channel_availability: Visual review confirms three co-composed panels in each MP4: white-light, green pseudocolor overlay, and grayscale fluorescence. These are embedded display panels and cannot be treated as raw independently synchronized channels.
records.labels: Narrative video captions and visually marked hepatic-congestion regions only; no pixel segmentation masks, raw channel files, bone-surface labels, or necrotic-transition-viable bone labels
records.clinical_variables_unavailable_reason: No patient-level age, sex, comorbidity, medication, laboratory, or blood-index table is published with the two videos.
records.recommended_use: Three-panel video decoding, channel-layout detection, white-light/fluorescence/overlay display quality checks, ICG temporal-signal robustness, and ignore/abstention engineering validation after frame-level review.
records.prohibited_use: No jaw-osteomyelitis, bone-viability, patient-conditioned segmentation, raw-channel registration, diagnostic, resection-boundary, navigation, or clinical-performance claim.
records.data_boundary: Public CC BY 4.0 human hepatic-surgery ICG supplementary videos. The embedded three-panel display is useful for software engineering checks while remaining non-jaw, non-bone, and non-target-domain. The videos provide no jaw-osteomyelitis ground truth, trusted bone surface, bone-activity classes, patient clinical table, or raw independently synchronized channels. Training admission remains false.

medical_boundary: D091 is restricted to public non-target-domain ICG three-panel video engineering validation. It remains excluded from target-domain training, raw-channel registration claims, bone-activity claims, and clinical performance claims.
